style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, a heavy realistic serpent, horror jump scare, hard noon sun
motion_rule: she never stops: a sidewinding sprint from the first frame, her body swinging wide, the camera racing backwards so a whole billboard sweeps out of frame every half second and her face stays to the lens; her head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 8.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a huge heavy female serpent, oily dark olive scales going black along the spine, brown diamond blotches, a broad blunt head, pale yellow-green slit eyes, long fangs, a grey collector waistcoat, deadpan
second_characters: ONE white mouse crossing the road, first beat only; ONE grey rat in a red visor sprinting at the lens, flinging bills
props: overdue bill sheets the rat flings, each with a big red stamp; a paper maw of folded bills, crease teeth, low on the tarmac
prop_continuity: the red stamp stays readable; the maw arrives already folded, runs on the tarmac beside her, never on her head; speech is only heard, never shown

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a cold sibilant female voice, a dry snake hiss on every word, s and sh drawn out without adding syllables, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one breath 0.0-1.5, 2.8-4.4, 5.4-9.0; silent 1.5-2.8, 4.4-5.4; after 9.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a long low hiss under every line, scales hissing over tarmac all clip, paper storm, a heavy thud on each lunge, a wet gulp at 1.4, a paper clap at 7.0

environment: a sunlit motorway, red stamped loan billboards flashing past

timeline.a: she sidewinds hard across the frame, coils pumping, the white mouse bolting across the tarmac ahead
she scoops the mouse up in her jaws at full drive, gone in one gulp, a lump running down her neck
she throws herself into the lens, jaws wide, fangs first, then drops back still driving
she bursts head first through a billboard into the lens, boards blowing apart
her tail whips a billboard pole into a blizzard of bills streaking backwards
head on to the lens, driving hard, bills wiping the lens
she strikes at the lens, fangs first, filling the frame, then whips back
the paper maw drops onto the tarmac and snaps twice at the rat heels as he sprints at the lens
she drives head on at the lens, the maw hurtling along the tarmac behind her
the maw catches the rat from behind at a full run and claps shut over him, all of it still hurtling
the shut paper parcel sprints level with her, a rat shaped bulge punching it from inside, legs pumping
her head fills the frame head on, billboards strobing past, the parcel pumping beside her
she throws herself into the lens and her open jaws swallow the whole frame, fangs and pink gullet filling it, held to the last frame

must_appear: at 1.0 she takes the mouse whole in one gulp on the run; she throws herself into the lens, jaws wide, at 1.5, 2.2 and 4.4; from 7.2 a rat shaped bulge punches the shut paper from inside while the parcel runs beside her; at 9.0 her open jaws swallow the whole frame and stay wide to the last frame
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, letterbox, night, a cute cartoon snake, a cobra hood, a human, a male voice, walls of banknotes, a mouse after 1.5, a stopped snake, a hero seen from behind, jaws closing at the end, pulling back at the end, cyrillic letters
